content.short: WorldFirst is a cross-border business account and FX platform for SMEs and e-commerce sellers, part of Ant Group.
content.description: WorldFirst is a cross-border business payments platform, now part of Ant Group, that helps SMEs and e-commerce sellers collect, hold, convert and send money across global markets. Through its World Account, businesses get local receiving accounts in many currencies, competitive foreign exchange, supplier payments and tools tailored to online sellers on marketplaces like Amazon and eBay. Popular with importers, exporters and cross-border merchants, especially across Asia, WorldFirst focuses on making it easy to get paid by overseas platforms and pay suppliers abroad without maintaining multiple foreign bank accounts. By combining multi-currency accounts, FX and marketplace-friendly features, it works as a practical treasury and payments platform for globally trading businesses.
